source_name: NBS – Kryté dlhopisy: legislation & Vestník NBS (opatrenia o registri krytých dlhopisov)
why_relevant: Sets the legal content of the covered-bond register that each issuing bank must maintain (cover-pool composition, valuations, programme rights/obligations) — e.g. Opatrenie NBS č. 13/2018 as amended by č. 5/2023. Knowing the mandated register schema tells the analyst exactly which cover-pool data fields banks must be able to report, and hence what to expect in their investor/cover-pool reporting.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam schválených kótovacích prospektov cenných papierov
why_relevant: NBS's index of approved listing particulars/prospectuses — an event log of which issuer got which instrument approved and when. Useful as a low-volume trigger feed: a new approval for a bank signals an imminent bond/covered-bond issue and a fresh, information-dense prospectus landing in CERI.

source_name: NBS – Burza cenných papierov / trh cenných papierov supervision pages
why_relevant: Regulator's description of the exchange, its market segments and the free public information BCPB must provide (15-minute delayed online trading data, issuer and member lists, statistics, publications). Confirms the free-vs-paid boundary of BCPB data and provides authoritative pointers into the exchange for a crawler.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – dlhopisy a hypotekárne záložné listy / prospectus hub
why_relevant: Issuer-side mirror of the regulated disclosure for Slovakia's largest bank (Erste Group): base prospectuses, final terms (konečné podmienky) and issue-level pages for covered bonds and senior bonds. Issuer sites often expose the documents earlier and in cleaner, directly-linkable PDF form than the register UI, and carry the English versions.

source_name: VÚB banka – Prospekty cenných papierov / kryté dlhopisy
why_relevant: VÚB (Intesa Sanpaolo) publishes NBS-approved prospectuses, supplements (dodatky k základnému prospektu), summary documents (súhrnný dokument) and per-series covered-bond pages, plus English covered-bond investor presentations with Slovak market share and mortgage-market data. Directly evidences the covered-bond programme size and admission to the BCPB regulated market.

source_name: Tatra banka – Kryté dlhopisy / ekonomické výsledky (covered bonds terms & prospectus)
why_relevant: Third of the SK big-three (Raiffeisen/RBI group). Publishes base prospectus, final terms, terms and conditions for its covered-bond programme alongside economic results — the issuer-side regulated-disclosure channel for a bank whose parent reports abroad, so SK-specific numbers are best sourced here.

source_name: ESAP – European Single Access Point (ESMA)
why_relevant: Forward-looking structural change to exactly this cell: from 10 July 2026 collection bodies (i.e. NBS/CERI as the SK OAM) begin feeding Transparency Directive, Prospectus Regulation and Short Selling Regulation data to ESAP, with public access by July 2027, in machine-readable form and free of charge. Once live, ESAP becomes a single cross-border, structured substitute for scraping CERI and 26 other national mechanisms — the collection architecture for this cell should be designed to migrate to it.

source_name: CERI – Notices & Manuals (notice_4, notice_5, /manuals)
why_relevant: Operational documentation of the filing mechanism: ESEF submission notice, rules on electronically signing auditors' reports, XHTML templates, and user manuals. These describe the exact file formats, naming and signature wrappers a collector will encounter when downloading SK bank annual financial reports — essential for building a robust parser rather than guessing.

source_name: BCPB market data / price list (kurzový lístok) and Provision of Information
why_relevant: Daily kurzový lístok is the machine-friendliest evidence of which bank instruments are actually admitted and traded, with 15-minute-delayed intraday data published free on the exchange site during the trading day. Provides the instrument-level universe that anchors the disclosure crawl and reveals new admissions/delistings quickly.

source_name: NBS – Registre dohliadaných subjektov (registre.nbs.sk)
why_relevant: Central NBS gateway to all supervised-entity registers (banking, capital market, payment services, intermediaries). Canonical way to enumerate every SK bank, branch of a foreign bank, payment institution and e-money institution that carries a Pillar 3 / disclosure obligation, and therefore the seed list for all downstream prudential-disclosure crawling.

source_name: NBS – Register podľa PSD2 (subjekty.nbs.sk JSON API)
why_relevant: PSD2 register of payment institutions, e-money institutions and agents. Covers the payments half of the run scope, where Pillar 3 does not apply but the equivalent compelled supervisory disclosure is register entry + licence scope. Search results indicate a machine-readable endpoint (subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2) returning JSON — high-value structured feed if confirmed.

source_name: NBS – Legislatíva: Opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014 o uverejňovaní informácií bankami a pobočkami zahraničných bánk (incl. amendment 8/2023)
why_relevant: The legal instrument that defines WHAT every Slovak bank must disclose, in which tables, and at what frequency (alongside CRR Part Eight). Reading it tells the collector exactly which structured tables to expect in each bank's 'Informácie o banke' PDF and when a template change will break parsers. Amendments (13/2015, 15/2018, 8/2023) signal schema shifts.

source_name: NBS – Pilier III: Výkazníctvo a zverejňovanie (poisťovníctvo / Solvency II)
why_relevant: NBS opinions/positions on Pillar III reporting and disclosure. NOISY TERM WARNING: in SK, 'Pilier III' most often refers to the Solvency II insurance pillar or the third pension pillar, not banking CRR Pillar 3. Useful as a supervisory-expectation source and as a disambiguation anchor for query design.

source_name: Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií (Slovak Resolution Council) – official site
why_relevant: The national resolution authority for SK institutions outside the SRB's direct remit. Sets MREL for institutions incorporated in Slovakia, publishes legislation, activity pages and public-facing explanations. The separate legal channel and cadence this cell is about.

source_name: Rezolučná rada – Vybrané právoplatné rozhodnutia (selected final decisions)
why_relevant: The statutory publication channel for resolution decisions affecting named SK institutions. A first entry here would be a high-signal event (institution failing or likely to fail, resolution tool applied). Search snippet suggests the page is currently empty — that emptiness is itself the signal, and the page must be monitored rather than dismissed.

source_name: Rezolučná rada – Publications and articles (incl. Biatec archive, bail-in guide)
why_relevant: Confirmed by fetch: hosts a bail-in mechanism guide ('Principles and Execution of the Bail-in Tool', per EBA/GL/2023/01), 2011-2021 Biatec journal articles on MREL, DGS risk-based contributions, SRM implementation and cross-border resolution. Good for methodology and for understanding how the SK authority reasons about MREL calibration.

source_name: NBS – Jednotný fond pre riešenie krízových situácií / Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií (institutional pages)
why_relevant: NBS-hosted explanation of the Resolution Council's mandate and of the Single Resolution Fund contributions collected from SK banks. Useful for mapping which body publishes what, and for the SRF contribution angle (a recurring compelled payment/disclosure event for SK banks).

source_name: Fond ochrany vkladov (FOV) – Slovak Deposit Protection Fund
why_relevant: Statutory deposit guarantee scheme under Act 118/1996 Z.z. Confirmed by fetch to publish annual reports, national and EU legislation, the list of participating banks, and payout information — i.e. an authoritative, independently-maintained roster of every deposit-taking institution in SK plus fund-level financials.

source_name: FOV – Výročné správy (annual reports PDF archive)
why_relevant: Multi-year PDF series with audited financial statements of the DGS: fund balance, contributions collected from member banks, coverage ratios. Structured, comparable year over year. Confirmed sample PDFs exist for 2020 and 2023 under a stable /wp-content/uploads/ pattern.

source_name: Garančný fond investícií (GFI) – investor compensation scheme
why_relevant: The investment-services counterpart to FOV (Act 566/2001, §80), covering securities dealers and management companies up to EUR 50,000. NBS-supervised, and a compelled-disclosure body in the same family as FOV. I could not confirm a standalone official GFI domain in this pass — this is a pointer to a documented description while the primary site is located.

source_name: VÚB banka – Informácie o činnosti banky / Pillar III disclosures (SK + EN)
why_relevant: The most consistently indexed SK Pillar 3 publisher. Quarterly PDFs under a highly regular, machine-predictable path (.../{year}/informacie-cinnosti-banky/Pillar_III_{YYYY-MM}_SK|EN/...), with parallel English versions — a rare bilingual structured series. Covers CRR Part Eight tables: own funds, RWAs, leverage, LCR/NSFR, encumbrance, credit risk.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Informácie a finančné ukazovatele (Pillar 3 disclosures)
why_relevant: Largest SK bank and an ECB-significant institution. Publishes disclosures under Opatrenie 16/2014 (as amended by 13/2015 and 15/2018) plus CRR 575/2013. PDFs are served both from slsp.sk and from the Erste Group CDN (cdn0.erstegroup.com), so a collector must cover both hosts.

source_name: Tatra banka – Ostatné informácie / Zverejňovanie informácií za skupinu Tatra banka
why_relevant: ECB-significant SK institution (Raiffeisen group). Confirmed landing page for group-level disclosures under Opatrenie 16/2014 + CRR, with quarterly PDFs archived under /files/archiv/financne-ukazovatele/ostatne-informacie/. Naming is Slovak-prose ('informacie-o-banke-k-31-marcu-2025.pdf'), so URL enumeration needs SK month names.

source_name: ČSOB (Československá obchodná banka, a.s. SK) – Informácie zverejňované ročne / štvrťročne
why_relevant: KBC-group SK bank publishing disclosures under Opatrenie 16/2014. Found a directly-linked annual disclosure PDF under a stable /documents/ path with the filename pattern 'Informacie_zverejnovane_rocne_k_31122020.pdf', which implies a parallel 'zverejnovane_stvrtrocne' series worth probing.

source_name: J&T BANKA (SK branch) – Zverejňované informácie / Povinné informácie
why_relevant: Branch of a foreign (CZ) bank — a distinct disclosure regime under Opatrenie 16/2014 (pobočky zahraničných bánk disclose a reduced set). Confirmed dedicated 'povinné informácie' section, making it a clean, stable entry point.

source_name: Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa (PSS) – Informácie o Banke
why_relevant: Building-society bank (stavebná sporiteľňa) — a specifically Slovak/Central-European institution type with its own act, still subject to the 16/2014 disclosure regime. Confirmed PDF at a date-prefixed path ('2022-12-31-Informacie-o-banke.pdf'), which is trivially enumerable by quarter-end.

source_name: 365.bank – povinne zverejňované informácie o banke
why_relevant: Major SK retail bank (formerly Poštová banka). Capital adequacy disclosures surface through press coverage (total capital adequacy 22.56% for 2023), implying an underlying 'informácie o banke' disclosure series that this pass did not locate directly on the bank's own site.

source_name: EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub (P3DH)
why_relevant: STRUCTURAL GAME-CHANGER for this cell. Live since 26 January 2026 for large and 'other' institutions: a centralised EEA platform where banks submit Pillar 3 disclosures as structured Data Point Model data rather than PDFs. This will progressively supersede per-bank PDF scraping for SK banks, and is the single highest-leverage source to onboard. A discussion paper extends it to small and non-complex institutions with EBA-computed disclosures.
